open_questions: Confirm whether LADBS requires electrical plan check for residential optional standby generators / transfer switches or interlocks under LAMC 93.0206 or P/GI 2026-003 (check full text of https://dbs.lacity.gov/services/plan-review-permitting/electrical-permits and https://dbs.lacity.gov/start under 'Install a home battery or generator').

Verify the exact EV charger demand/load factor line and footnotes on IN-Form.00 (https://dbs.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/efs/forms/inspection/sfd-electrical-vehicle-charger-service-load-calculation-form-in-form-00.pdf) and whether LADBS accepts NEC 220.82/220.83 optional calculations for service upgrades, subpanels, appliance circuits, generators, or solar+storage.

Confirm residential electrical plan check PDF upload specifications, copy counts, and C-10 contractor vs. California Registered Electrical Engineer signature requirements under LAMC 93.0206(a) on https://dbs.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/efs/forms/pc17/city-of-los-angeles-electrical-plan-check-correction-list.pdf and ePlanLA guidelines.

Verify full submittal checklist items for residential service upgrades (>320A or >400A) in LADWP Guide to Electric Service (https://www.ladwp.com/sites/default/files/documents/Guide_to_Electric_Service.pdf), including exact wording for the 2-copy load schedule and plot plan requirements.
Verify whether LADBS has issued a 2026 revision to Information Bulletin P/GI 2023-027 for solar PV and energy storage systems (https://dbs.lacity.gov/node/3977).

Information Bulletin P/GI 2026-003 (Express Permits) lists an effective date of 01-01-2026 and revised date 06-10-2026 in the snippet, but the file URL returned by search is ib-p-gi-2020-003-express-permits_rev-5-28-2024.pdf; verify full current text of P/GI 2026-003 on dbs.lacity.gov (https://dbs.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/efs/forms/pc17/ib-p-gi-2020-003-express-permits_rev-5-28-2024.pdf).

Information Bulletin P/GI 2023-027 (Guidelines for Plan Check and Permit Requirements for Solar Energy Devices) is hosted at /sites/default/files/efs/forms/pc17/ib-p-gi-2020-027.pdf and dated 01/01/2023; verify whether a 2026 revision of P/GI 2023-027 has been issued under the 2025 CEC (https://dbs.lacity.gov/node/3977).

Specific LADBS residential electrical plan check rules for standalone generator transfer switches/interlocks and standardized sheet size/PDF submittal specifications for residential electrical plans were not returned in search snippets; verify on https://dbs.lacity.gov/services/plan-review-permitting/electrical-permits.
